# Security Policy

NHSMM is pre-1.0 research software. Security fixes are applied to the current development line; older snapshots are not maintained as supported release branches.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security-sensitive issues privately through GitHub Security Advisories for `awa-si/nhsmm` when available. Do not open a public issue for an unpatched vulnerability.

Include the affected version or commit, a minimal reproduction, expected impact, and any known mitigation. Reports are triaged on a best-effort basis; no response-time SLA is implied.
